interface.longDescription: Vibe Code Security Reviewer performs advanced evidence-based security reviews of AI-generated and rapidly built applications. It checks Supabase RLS, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, API leaks and misuse, inputs, secrets, uploads, dependencies, data exposure, AI tools, deployment configuration, and abuse paths, then prioritizes findings with practical remediation and verification steps.
